Nina L.: Quick heads-up — the handbook link we reference in the new-hire checklist (https://kb.internal/handbook/model-onboarding) is redirecting to the updated slug and our old anchor /#quickstart now 404s in search previews. Anyone can add a short redirect or alias? small frontmatter patch.
doc-bot: Automated scan: found 301 redirect from /handbook/model-onboarding -> /handbook/model-onboarding-v2; fragment '#quickstart' missing on target. Recommend adding `aliases` frontmatter or adding manual anchor to v2 page.
Omar V.: I can open PR to add `aliases: ["/handbook/model-onboarding#quickstart"]` to the v2 frontmatter. That's the minimal change without touching visible headings.
Kei H.: Heads up, codeowners for /handbook are `@handbook-maintainers` — tag them in PR.
Maya P.: Also check search indexes and onboarding checklist links in the repo: `rg \"model-onboarding#quickstart\" -n` and in onboarding infra (scripts).
Nina L.: I'll run the grep and include results. Proposed frontmatter snippet: 
```yaml
---
title: "Model onboarding (v2)"
aliases:
  - "/handbook/model-onboarding#quickstart"
---
```
Nina L.: plan: open PR with alias + changelog line + ripgrep output; tag @handbook-maintainers. Will wait ~30m for objections.
Omar V.: I can fast-approve once owners ACK.
Kei H.: small nit: also add `redirect_from` for the bare path maybe: `redirect_from: ["/handbook/model-onboarding"]` — avoids other 301s.
Maya P.: Good call. If you want, I can update onboarding checklist after merge.
Nina L.: Opening PR in ~15m, will ping here when up :+1:
